description: There is no signal when Zug isn't accumulating knowledge. A user could run 10 sessions where the AI never calls zug_save_observation and have no indication the memory system is idle. Add a diagnostic to zug_get_context and/or zug_status: if observation count hasn't changed since the last N sessions, surface a visible warning ("Zug hasn't recorded any observations in the last 3 sessions — consider calling zug_save_observation when you notice patterns"). Also expose observation-per-session rate in zug_status so users can see at a glance whether the system is working.
title: Learning feedback loop — surface when Zug hasn't grown from recent sessions
